name: AppMintly Publisher Console
purpose: A self-service publishing workspace where developers prepare app records, submit releases for validation, and track their catalog entries end to end.
intendedUsers: Independent developers publishing apps to AppMintly
proposedFeatures: App record editor with live catalog preview
Release submission with automatic SHA-256 integrity evidence
Submission status tracking from draft to published
plannedCapabilities: Edit draft app metadata (name, description, category, icons)
Attach a validated APK release to a draft record
See the exact public catalog card a record will produce

milestones.title: Record editor and release validation flow

draftNote: Draft roadmap entry — content is maintained by the AppMintly team and may change before launch.

name: AppMintly Register
purpose: Identity and onboarding for the AppMintly ecosystem, so publishers can claim and verify their developer identity before publishing.
proposedFeatures: Developer identity registration and profile claim
Verified publisher badge for catalog records
Link between publisher identity and published apps
plannedCapabilities: Associate published catalog apps with the identity
Show verified publisher status on the storefront

name: PDFly
purpose: A fast, private PDF toolkit: merge, split, compress and convert documents entirely in the browser.
intendedUsers: Students and office workers handling daily document tasks
Anyone who wants PDF tools without uploading files to a server
proposedFeatures: Merge, split and rotate PDF files locally
No-file-upload privacy: processing stays in the browser

milestones.title: Core PDF tools in the browser
